title: The Wilful Child
summary: A stubborn child refused to obey his mother in anything. When he died and was buried, his little arm repeatedly reached out through the grave earth....
full_text:
A stubborn child refused to obey his mother in anything. When he died and was buried, his little arm repeatedly reached out through the grave earth.

Only when his weeping mother struck the little hand with a birch rod did it withdraw, allowing his spirit to rest in peaceful submission before God.
moral: Stubborn obstinacy against loving counsel brings sorrow to the soul.
